fields.name: access_key
fields.help: Access Key from Mintegral AppGrowth > Account Management > Basic Information; sent as the access-key header of every Open API call.

fields.name: api_key
fields.help: API Key from the same Basic Information page; never sent, only used to compute the per-request token = md5(api_key + md5(timestamp)).

adapter.terms: Mintegral Open API (https://adv-new.mintegral.com/doc/en/guide/introduction/token.html): every call carries the headers access-key, timestamp (seconds) and token = Md5(API key.md5(timestamp)) ('$token = md5($api_key.md5($timestamp))'); answers {code (200 = success), msg, data}. API access is self-serve for registered AppGrowth advertisers; offers maintained by an account manager (maintain_by = AM) are read-only.

me.note: GET /api/open/v1/account/balance verifies the key pair and answers data.list [{user_id, username, currency, balance}].

list_accounts.note: The only account-level call is Get Account Balance: data.list holds the account(s) the key belongs to with {user_id, username, currency, balance}.

list_campaigns.note: Lists offers (GET /api/open/v1/offers, at most 50 per page): in Mintegral the offer is the unit that carries budget, bid and RUNNING/STOPPED status, while a 'campaign' is the promoted app; so campaign ids used by update_budget and pause_resume are offer_ids. status filters by offer status (e.g. RUNNING, STOPPED). Budgets are per-region arrays (raw.budget: [{country_code, total_budget, daily_cap_type, daily_cap}]) and are not flattened. account_id is not sent: the access key selects the account. Parameters are sent as a query string (the reference's GET example shows them as a JSON object; the same API's audience list documents them in the query).

update_budget.note: PUT /api/open/v1/offer/budget {offer_id, budget: [{country_code: ALL, daily_cap_type: BUDGET, daily_cap, total_budget: OPEN}]} sets one daily spend cap (whole units of the account currency, minimum 50) for all regions of the offer; this spends money, replaces any per-region budgets and leaves the total budget open ('"OPEN" means no budget'). daily_budget must be a whole number; currency is ignored.

pause_resume.note: PUT /api/open/v1/offer/status {offer_id, status: RUNNING|STOPPED} starts or pauses one offer (pause → STOPPED, resume → RUNNING). Resuming restarts spend.

not_offered.get_report: The only performance report is asynchronous and returns a file: 'Calling this interface is divided into two steps: First you need to set the parameter type = 1 … The system will generate data asynchronously … After the data is generated, set the parameter type = 2 … will directly return the file byte stream (Content-Type: application / octet-stream) … separated by "\t" as columns' (https://adv-new.mintegral.com/doc/en/guide/report/advancedPerformanceReport.html).
